pages.text: A Portable Akaishi Cell is a $(4)pocket power bank$(0).$(br2)$(bold)Three tiers$(0) (capacity / per-tick charge & output):$(li)Basic: 50 million / 500 thousand$(li)Advanced: 200 million / 1 million$(li)Super: 1 billion / 4 million$(br2)$(bold)How to use it:$(0)just carry it in your inventory. When Akaishi curios run dry, they $(4)automatically draw power from the Portable Cells in your backpack$(0) — and it also patches up your equipped Akaishi gear. Details on the next page.

$(bold)Auto-repair:$(0)a Portable Cell anywhere in your inventory continuously repairs the Akaishi gear on your body and in your hands:$(li)Basic: 10 durability per tick$(li)Advanced: 20 durability per tick$(li)Super: 40 durability per tick$(br2)Each point of durability costs $(bold)100 AE$(0). Several cells in the bag $(4)stack their power$(0) — when one runs dry, the next takes over automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Recharging:$(0)drop the Portable Cell into the charge slot of a "$(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Storage Cell$(/l)" GUI.

It travels, while the block-sized cells stay home — the capacity ladder is in "$(l:akaishi:energy_basics)Akaishi Energy Basics$(/l)" and "$(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Storage$(/l)". It shines brightest with "$(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l)" and "$(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l)".
